scope: Analysis of the already frozen fresh selection only; does not change acquisition, generation, training, native or cost budgets

arms.retrieval: same original parent with frozen retrieval rule
arms.final_only: child after its original eight updates

contrasts.metric: mean(child actual native success - frozen parent actual native success) over the four fixed tasks
mean(child actual native success - parent-plus-retrieval actual native success) over the four fixed tasks

statistics.optional_exact_two_sided_paired_sign_tes: Conditional on discordant task pairs within each mode; label all planned contrasts and do not claim multiplicity-adjusted confirmation
statistics.confidence_scope: Four fixed selected tasks from distinct owners; selection and task-family limitations retained. No population or real-user scaling claim.

missingness.panel_refused: Do not generate/evaluate a replacement panel. No fresh performance estimate.
missingness.incomplete_arm_or_uncertain_native_clean: Report attempted slots and actual terminal states; complete paired comparison remains unavailable. Do not drop missing tasks, impute success, restart arms or select a favorable completed subset.
missingness.actual_output_cap_refusal: Record task failure under the frozen policy and retain no-native-call status.
missingness.actual_native_test_failure: Record task failure and original complete native receipt.

limitations: The frozen source commit cutoff precedes training; this is after-freeze source acquisition, not evidence of tasks newly arising after training.
Old evaluations remain exposed and cannot re-enter as unseen data.

Fresh task improvement does not itself prove retention of all old abilities, native adoption, real next-task benefit, multi-teacher inheritance, Circuit necessity, user scaling, or useful-work settlement.
